literal: "$n interlaces $s fingers and slowly fades from view."
"A strong force jolts $n in $s attempt to leave north."
"You ignore the elements that barrage you.\n\r"
"You crouch in the shadows and plan your ambush...\r\n"
"You'll need to hold a set of lockpicks before you can pick a lock!\r\n"
"$N is not in a proper position for that."
"$n is struck by four beams of colored light and slowly vanishes!"
"The guard humiliates you, and blocks your way.\r\n"
"$n is startled as $N is saved by the powers of the gods!"
"That can only be done to a beast!\r\n"
"$p decays in your hands, and the contents fall to the ground."
"You feel a strange presence as $n appears, seemingly from nowhere."
"$n taps you and screams, 'TAG! You're it!'"
"You can't do this and wield a weapon at the same time!\r\n"
"I'm sure you don't want to insult *everybody*...\r\n"
"Nah, you're too much of a badass to go in there!"
"Sorry, you can't donate anything right now.\r\n"
"The Mortician dumps your corpse on the ground."
"The pile of dust is blown away by a draft of wind.\r\n"
"You feel your soul wrenched as you are pulled into a different reality.\r\n"
"Your blood freezes as you hear someone's death cry."
"$N has been kicked out of $n's group!"
"$n is mortally wounded, and will die soon, if not aided."
"Heh heh heh ... we are jolly funny today, eh?\r\n"
"A ray of light shoots out from one of $n's eyestalks, breaking your concentration!"
"%s I can only afford to buy %d of those."
"You can't recall from this magickal place.\r\n"
"Go outside if you want to ride!\r\n"
"A shimmering portal of blue light suddenly appears in the darkness!"
"%s I don't buy used up wands or staves!"
"$n grabs $N by the collar, and quickly beats $M into submission.\r\nJerking $M to $S feet, $n carts $N off to jail."
"$N is just such a good friend, you simply can't strike $M."
"Sorry, the mail system is having technical difficulties.\r\n"
"A %s cylinder of light extends upwards from the pillar."
"$n falls to $s knees, clutching $s groin and throwing up\r\neverywhere!"
